fused_training_law_delta.producer_lineage: A source-lineage field is not verified merely because its commit string is well formed; promotion-grade lineage requires repository-object/path/blob/ancestry plus executed HEAD/tree binding or equivalent exact attestation.

hypothesis_fusion.hypothesis: Git-object-bound A02 producer lineage will reject self-consistent but unverifiable source claims while preserving the valid current baseline.
hypothesis_fusion.counterhypothesis: Authority-pinned current source SHA-256 plus clean-checkout HEAD/tree receipt is already sufficient, making per-lineage Git-object verification redundant.
hypothesis_fusion.cheapest_discriminator: Mutate source_commit_sha to a syntactically valid nonexistent commit and to a real non-ancestor commit. The repaired proof path must reject both before producer credit, while the real authority lineage passes.

hypothesis_fusion.hypothesis: A generation receipt that omits exact authority-manifest identity can become time-dependent under schema-valid authority evolution at the same path.
hypothesis_fusion.counterhypothesis: A mandatory exact historical HEAD/tree envelope already provides the immutable replay root and makes row-level manifest digest redundant.
hypothesis_fusion.cheapest_discriminator: Run T2_A03_AUTHORITY_DRIFT_MUTATION; historical verification must reject changed-manifest replay unless exact historical manifest identity is independently receipt-bound or outer-envelope-bound.

hypothesis_fusion.hypothesis: A small model can score highly on state-update endpoints while using cheap parity/count/event-multiset/serialization invariants instead of ordered recurrent state tracking.
hypothesis_fusion.counterhypothesis: The model learns the intended order-sensitive process and remains correct when shortcut signatures are matched or neutralized.
hypothesis_fusion.cheapest_discriminator_after_provenance_: Evaluate matched-history pairs with identical multiset/count/length/nuisance and parity-like signatures but different order/U_state outcome; score every prefix, not only final state.
